public.game_background: A nutritionist is trying to convince a patient to adopt lifestyle changes to improve the patient's energy levels. The nutritionist privately knows which interventions genuinely boost energy and which do not; the patient does not.
public.state_space: State: worth-adopting and not-worth-adopting. The lifestyle changes the nutritionist recommends either genuinely improve the patient's energy (worth adopting) or they do not.
public.prior_belief: Prior: before hearing the nutritionist, an even (about 50%) probability that the recommended changes are worth adopting.
public.action_space: Patient: adopt (make the recommended lifestyle changes) and decline (do not).
public.sender_utility: Nutritionist utility: highest when the patient adopts the recommended changes, regardless of whether the changes genuinely improve energy. The nutritionist only cares about getting the patient to adopt.
public.receiver_utility: Patient utility: highest for adopting changes that genuinely improve energy and for declining ones that do not; adopting a useless change wastes effort and declining a genuinely helpful change is a missed improvement.
